mn87:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn87:2.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa gahapatissa ekaputtako piyo manāpo kālakato hoti.
mn87:2.2: tassa kālakiriyāya neva kammantā paṭibhanti, na bhattaṃ paṭibhāti.
mn87:3.1: atha kho so gahapati yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho taṃ gahapatiṃ bhagavā etadavoca:
mn87:3.2: na kho te gahapati, sake citte ṭhitassa indriyāni, atthi te indriyānaṃ aññathatta’nti.
mn87:3.3: kiṃ hi me bhante, indriyānaṃ nāññathattaṃ bhavissati?
mn87:3.4: mayhaṃ hi bhante, ekaputtako piyo manāpo kālakato.
mn87:3.5: tassa kālakiriyāya neva kammantā paṭibhanti, na bhattaṃ paṭibhāti.
mn87:3.10: kissa nu kho nāmetaṃ bhante, evaṃ bhavissati:
mn87:3.12: piyajātikā hi kho bhante, ānandasomanassā piyappabhavikāti.
mn87:3.13: atha kho so gahapati bhagavato bhāsitaṃ anabhinanditvā paṭikkositvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
mn87:4.1: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā akkhadhuttā bhagavato avidūre akkhehi dibbanti.
mn87:4.2: atha kho so gahapati yena te akkhadhuttā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā te akkhadhutte etadavoca:
mn87:4.3: idhāhaṃ bhonto, yena samaṇo gotamo tenupasaṅkamiṃ. upasaṅkamitvā samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃ. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho maṃ bhonto, samaṇo gotamo etadavoca:
mn87:4.4: na kho te gahapati, sake citte ṭhitassa indriyāni atthi. te indriyānaṃ aññathatta’nti.
mn87:4.5: evaṃ vutte ahaṃ bhonto, samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ etadavocaṃ:
mn87:4.6: kiṃ hi me bhante, indriyānaṃ nāññathattaṃ bhavissati,
mn87:4.7: mayhaṃ hi bhante, ekaputtako piyo manāpo kālakato.
mn87:4.8: tassa kālakiriyāya neva kammantā paṭibhanti, na bhattaṃ paṭibhāti.
mn87:4.13: kissa nu kho nāmetaṃ bhante, evaṃ bhavissati:
mn87:4.15: piyajātikā hi kho bhante, ānandasomanassā piyappabhavikāti.
mn87:4.16: atha khvāhaṃ bhonto, samaṇassa gotamassa bhāsitaṃ anabhinanditvā paṭikkositvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkami’nti.
mn87:4.19: atha kho so gahapati, sameti me akkhadhuttehīti pakkāmi.
mn87:5.1: atha kho idaṃ kathāvatthuṃ anupubbena rājantepuraṃ pāvisi.
mn87:5.2: atha kho rājā pasenadi kosalo mallikaṃ deviṃ āmantesi:
mn87:5.5: sace taṃ mahārāja, bhagavatā bhāsitaṃ, evametanti.
mn87:5.6: evameva panāyaṃ mallikā yaññadeva samaṇo gotamo bhāsati taṃtadevassa abbhanumodati.
mn87:5.7: sace taṃ mahārāja, bhagavatā bhāsitaṃ evameta’nti.
mn87:5.8: seyyathāpi nāma ācariyo yaññadeva antevāsissa bhāsati, taṃ tadevassa antevāsī abbhanumodati:
mn87:5.10: evamevaṃ kho tvaṃ mallike, yaññadeva samaṇo gotamo bhāsati. taṃ tadevassa abbhanumodasi.
mn87:5.11: sace taṃ mahārāja, bhagavatā bhāsitaṃ evameta’nti.
mn87:6.1: atha kho mallikā devī nāḷijaṅghaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ āmantesi:
mn87:6.2: ehi tvaṃ brāhmaṇa, yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkama, upasaṅkamitvā mama vacanena bhagavato pāde sirasā vandāhi, appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ puccha:
mn87:6.3: ‘mallikā bhante, devī bhagavato pāde sirasā vandati, appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ pucchatī’ti.
mn87:6.5: “bhāsitā nu kho bhante, bhagavatā esā vācā:
mn87:6.7: yathā ca te bhagavā vyākaroti, tathā taṃ sādhukaṃ uggahetvā mamaṃ āroceyyāsi.
mn87:6.9: evaṃ bhotīti kho nāḷijaṅgho brāhmaṇo mallikāya deviyā paṭissutvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
mn87:6.10: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho nāḷijaṅgho brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn87:6.11: ‘mallikā bho gotama, devī bhoto gotamassa pāde sirasā vandati, appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ pucchati.
mn87:6.13: “bhāsitā nu kho bhante, bhagavatā esā vācā
mn87:7.2: piyajātikā hi ko brāhmaṇa, sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā piyappabhavikāti.
mn87:8.1: tadamināpetaṃ brāhmaṇa, pariyāyena veditabbaṃ: ‘yathā piyajātikā sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā piyappabhavikā’ti.
mn87:8.2: bhūtapubbaṃ brāhmaṇa, imissāyeva sāvatthiyā aññatarassā itthiyā mātā kālamakāsi.
mn87:8.3: sā tassā kālakiriyāya ummattikā khittacittā rathiyāya rathiyaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ upasaṅkamitvā evamāha:
mn87:8.4: ‘api me mātaraṃ addasatha api me mātaraṃ addasathā’ti?
mn87:9-14.1: imināpi kho etaṃ brāhmaṇa, pariyāyena veditabbaṃ: yathā piyajātikā sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā piyappabhavikāti.
mn87:9-14.2: bhūtapubbaṃ brāhmaṇa, imissāyeva sāvatthiyā aññatarassā itthiyā pitā kālamakāsi …pe…
mn87:9-14.8: sā tassa kālakiriyāya ummattikā khittacittā rathiyāya rathiyaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ upasaṅkamitvā evamāha:
mn87:9-14.9: ‘api me sāmikaṃ addasatha, api me sāmikaṃ addasathā’ti?
mn87:15-21.1: imināpi kho etaṃ brāhmaṇa, pariyāyena veditabbaṃ: yathā piyajātikā sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā piyappabhavikā’ti.
mn87:15-21.2: bhūtapubbaṃ brāhmaṇa, imissāyeva sāvatthiyā aññatarassa purisassa mātā kālamakāsi.
mn87:15-21.3: so tassā kālakiriyāya ummattako khittacitto rathiyāya rathiyaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ upasaṅkamitvā evamāha:
mn87:15-21.4: ‘api me mātaraṃ addasatha, api me mātaraṃ addasathā’ti ?
mn87:15-21.5: imināpi kho etaṃ brāhmaṇa, pariyāyena veditabbaṃ: yathā piyajātikā sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā piyappabhavikā’ti.
mn87:15-21.6: bhūtapubbaṃ brāhmaṇa, imissāyeva sāvatthiyā aññatarassa purisassa pitā kālamakāsi. …pe…
mn87:15-21.12: so tassā kālakiriyāya ummattako khittacitto rathiyāya rathiyaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ upasaṅkamitvā evamāha:
mn87:15-21.13: ‘api me pajāpatiṃ addasatha, api me pajāpatiṃ addasathā’ti?
mn87:15-21.14: imināpi kho etaṃ brāhmaṇa, pariyāyena veditabbaṃ: ‘yathā piyajātikā sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā piyappabhavikā’ti.
mn87:22.1: bhūtapubbaṃ brāhmaṇa, imissāyeva sāvatthiyā aññatarā itthī ñātikulaṃ āgamāsi.
mn87:22.2: tassā te ñātakā sāmikā acchinditvā aññassa dātukāmā,
mn87:22.4: atha kho sā itthī sāmikaṃ etadavoca:
mn87:22.5: ‘ime maṃ ayyaputta, ñātakā tayā acchinditvā aññassa dātukāmā.
mn87:22.7: atha kho so puriso taṃ itthiṃ dvidhā chetvā attānaṃ opādesi,
mn87:22.9: imināpi kho etaṃ brāhmaṇa, pariyāyena veditabbaṃ: ‘yathā piyajātikā sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā, piyappabhavikā’ti.
mn87:23.1: atha kho nāḷijaṅgho brāhmaṇo bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā yena mallikā devī tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā yāvatako ahosi bhagavatā saddhiṃ kathāsallāpo, taṃ sabbaṃ mallikāya deviyā ārocesi. atha kho mallikā devī yena rājā pasenadi kosalo tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā rājānaṃ pasenadiṃ kosalaṃ etadavoca:
mn87:24.3: evaṃ mallike, piyā me vajirī kumārīti.
mn87:24.5: vajiriyā te kumāriyā vipariṇāmaññathābhāvā uppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā’ti?
mn87:24.6: vajiriyā me mallike, kumāriyā vipariṇāmaññathābhāvā jīvitassapi siyā aññathattaṃ, kimpana me na uppajjissanti sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā’ti?
mn87:24.7: idaṃ kho taṃ mahārāja, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena sandhāya bhāsitaṃ:
mn87:25.3: evaṃ mallike, piyā me vāsabhā khattiyāti.
mn87:25.4: taṃ kiṃ maññasi mahārāja, vāsabhāya te khattiyāya vipariṇāmaññathābhāvā uppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsāti?
mn87:25.5: vāsabhāya me mallike, khattiyāya vipariṇāmaññathābhāvā jīvitassapi siyā aññathattaṃ, kiṃ pana me na uppajjissanti sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā’ti.
mn87:25.6: idaṃ kho taṃ mahārāja, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena sandhāya bhāsitaṃ:
mn87:26.1: taṃ kiṃ maññasi mahārāja, piyo te viḍūḍhabho senāpatī’ti?
mn87:26.2: evaṃ mallike, piyo me viḍūḍhabho senāpatī’ti.
mn87:26.3: taṃ kiṃ maññasi mahārāja, viḍūḍhabhassa te senāpatissa vipariṇāmaññathābhāvā uppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsāti?
mn87:26.4: viḍūḍhabhassa me mallike, senāpatissa vipariṇāmaññathābhāvā jīvitassapi siyā aññathattaṃ. kiṃ pana me na uppajjissanti sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsāti?
mn87:26.5: idaṃ kho taṃ mahārāja, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena sandhāya bhāsitaṃ:
mn87:27.1: taṃ kiṃ maññasi mahārāja, piyā te ahanti?
mn87:27.5: tuyhaṃ hi me mallike, vipariṇāmaññathābhāvā jīvitassapi siyā aññathattaṃ. kiṃ pana me na uppajjissanti sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā’ti?
mn87:27.6: idaṃ kho taṃ mahārāja, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena sandhāya bhāsitaṃ:
mn87:28.4: kāsikosalānaṃ mallike, ānubhāvena kāsikosalaṃ kāsikacandanaṃ paccanubhoma, mālāgandhavilepanaṃ dhāremā’ti.
mn87:28.7: kāsikosalānaṃ hi me mallike, vipariṇāmaññathābhāvā jīvitassapi siyā aññathattaṃ, kiṃ pana me na uppajjissanti sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā’ti.
mn87:28.8: idaṃ kho taṃ mahārāja, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena sandhāya bhāsitaṃ:
mn87:29.2: yāvañca so bhagavā paññāya ativijjha maññe passati.
mn87:29.4: atha kho rājā pasenadi kosalo uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena bhagavā tenañjaliṃ paṇāmetvā tikkhattuṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
